title: let Err(e) = h.await irrefutable pattern for outbox supervision
description: Using an irrefutable let-pattern on Result<!, JoinError> is idiomatic Rust and compiler-enforced: if outbox_worker ever changes from -> ! to a concrete return type, this pattern becomes refutable and the code won't compile. This is safer than a match with an unreachable!() Ok arm, which would only fail at runtime. Defend this if a contributor suggests 'simplifying' to a match arm.
